facts.fact: TechCabal reports that since January 2024 the BCEAO has applied Instruction no. 001-01-2024 on payment services, which obliges all fintechs offering payment services in the eight-state WAEMU/UEMOA zone to obtain a licence or stop; BEN is a member state the instruction binds.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction no. 001-01-2024 on payment services

systems.country_label: Plateforme Interoperable du Systeme de Paiement Instantane
systems.tiers: banks, mobile money operators and microfinance institutions across the eight UEMOA states

note: The only licence the document names is issued in Togo (Semoa, 29 January 2026), so no non-bank fact for BEN; no rule requiring providers to connect is stated.
